description: The credits of the plan ran out: HTTP 403. Our own account, so the request is set aside, not counted as a failure.
source: Built from the status-codes page (https://docs.scraperapi.com/responses-and-formats/api-status-codes.md): 403 means the credits are exhausted. Illustrative; the text of the body is not documented.

response.text: You have exhausted the API Credits available in this monthly cycle.
